title: 19th Sitting of first Session of 2025

items.text: Opening recitation (Hamd and Salawat); the sitting begins.
Roll call of members present at the sitting.
Announcement of the day's agenda (Agenda No. އޖ/19/1/2025).

From the Speaker's desk: the President's matter on appointing non-resident ambassadors of the Maldives to foreign countries, under Article 115(d) of the Constitution and Article 14 of the Foreign Service Act (Law No. 20/2021), is sent to the relevant standing committee for review.
Foreign Relations Committee report on the President's nomination of a non-resident ambassador to the Republic of Azerbaijan.
Voting on items from the day's business that have reached the voting stage.

summary: A short sitting that sent new non-resident ambassador nominations to committee and took up the committee report on the ambassador nominee for Azerbaijan.
